name: home-hero
description: Homepage hero: eyebrow, two-line title, lede, demo button and compliance badges beside the live Ursa demo, over a band of client logos that scrolls on phones. Live: #ap-home-hero-v2 on the homepage.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the title (the page H1, as on live).

title_accent.description: Title's second line, in the brand gradient. Line breaks are kept.

lede.description: Paragraph under it. Line breaks are kept.

secondary_label.description: Secondary button text (live hides it; kept for parity).

badges.description: Compliance badges. Each: image, alt, cls (sizing class, e.g. ap-compliance-img-soc2).

demo_url.description: The live Ursa demo, framed beside the copy. Its host only allows assetpanda.com to frame it; leave empty elsewhere to show the posters.

demo_title.description: Accessible title of the demo frame.

poster.description: Still of the demo at rest (desktop), shown when there is no demo_url.

logos_label.description: Heading of the client logo band.

logos_accent.description: Bold tail of that heading. Must appear in logos_label.

logos.description: Client logos. Each: image, alt, cls (sizing class, e.g. ap-logo-dyson), w, h (px, optional).
